def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # --- Только заказы, произошедшие до seed_time ---
    orders_hist = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time].copy()

    # Признаки заказа считаем только там, где информация уже известна на seed_time
    known_delivery = orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    orders_hist['delivery_time_days'] = np.where(
        known_delivery,
        (orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'] - orders_hist['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    known_est = orders_hist['order_estimated_delivery_date'].notna()
    late_mask = known_delivery & known_est & \
                (orders_hist['order_delivered_customer_date'] > orders_hist['order_estimated_delivery_date'])
    orders_hist['late'] = late_mask.astype(float)
    orders_hist.loc[~known_delivery, 'late'] = np.nan
    # статус "доставлен/отменён" определяем только по датам, известным на seed_time
    orders_hist['is_delivered'] = known_delivery.astype(int)
    known_carrier = orders_hist['order_delivered_carrier_date'].notna() & \
                    (orders_hist['order_delivered_carrier_date'] <= seed_time)
    canceled_known = (orders_hist['order_status'] == 'canceled') & \
                     (orders_hist['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time)
    orders_hist['is_canceled'] = canceled_known.astype(int)
    orders_hist['in_transit'] = (known_carrier & ~known_delivery).astype(int)

    order_cols = ['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                  'delivery_time_days', 'late', 'is_delivered', 'is_canceled', 'in_transit']

    # --- Только позиции, купленные до seed_time ---
    items_hist = order_items[order_items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    items_hist = items_hist[items_hist['product_id'].isin(set(entity_ids))]

    item_orders = items_hist.merge(orders_hist[order_cols], on='order_id', how='inner')
    basket_sizes = items_hist.groupby('order_id')['order_item_id'].count().rename('basket_size')
    item_orders = item_orders.merge(basket_sizes, on='order_id', how='left')
    item_orders['days_since_purchase'] = (seed_time - item_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days

    # --- Базовые агрегации по товару ---
    agg_item = item_orders.groupby('product_id').agg(
        count_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        count_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        unique_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        unique_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_time_days', 'mean'),
        late_rate=('late', 'mean'),
        delivered_orders=('is_delivered', 'sum'),
        canceled_orders=('is_canceled', 'sum'),
        in_transit_orders=('in_transit', 'sum'),
        avg_basket_size=('basket_size', 'mean'),
        first_order_ts=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'min'),
        last_order_ts=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'max'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
    ).reset_index()

    agg_item['std_price'] = agg_item['std_price'].fillna(0)
    agg_item['product_age_days'] = (seed_time - agg_item['first_order_ts']).dt.days
    agg_item['days_since_last_order'] = (seed_time - agg_item['last_order_ts']).dt.days
    agg_item['orders_per_day_active'] = agg_item['count_orders'] / \
        (agg_item['product_age_days'].replace(0, 1) + 1)
    price_span = agg_item['max_price'] - agg_item['min_price']
    agg_item['price_range'] = price_span.fillna(0)
    agg_item = agg_item.drop(columns=['first_order_ts', 'last_order_ts'])

    # --- Скользящие окна (только прошлое) ---
    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        mask = item_orders['days_since_purchase'] <= window
        sub = item_orders[mask]
        cols = {f'count_orders_{window}d': ('order_id', 'nunique'),
                f'sum_price_{window}d': ('price', 'sum'),
                f'unique_customers_{window}d': ('customer_id', 'nunique'),
                f'avg_price_{window}d': ('price', 'mean')}
        if not sub.empty:
            agg_win = sub.groupby('product_id').agg(**cols).reset_index()
            agg_item = agg_item.merge(agg_win, on='product_id', how='left')
        else:
            for c in cols:
                agg_item[c] = np.nan

    # Тренд: доля заказов в последних 30 днях от заказов в последних 90
    if 'count_orders_30d' in agg_item and 'count_orders_90d' in agg_item:
        agg_item['recent_momentum'] = agg_item['count_orders_30d'] / \
            agg_item['count_orders_90d'].replace(0, np.nan)

    # --- Платежи (только по заказам из прошлого, по времени покупки) ---
    order_ids = item_orders['order_id'].unique()
    payments_f = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(order_ids)].copy()
    if 'ts' in payments_f.columns:
        payments_f = payments_f[payments_f['ts'] <= seed_time]

    pay_agg = payments_f.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        count_payments=('payment_value', 'count'),
    ).reset_index()

    pay_dummies = pd.get_dummies(payments_f['payment_type'], prefix='pay_type')
    pay_dummies['order_id'] = payments_f['order_id'].values
    pay_dummies_agg = pay_dummies.groupby('order_id').sum().reset_index()
    pay_agg = pay_agg.merge(pay_dummies_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    product_orders = item_orders[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    product_pay = product_orders.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    pay_rate_cols = [c for c in pay_agg.columns if c.startswith('pay_type_')]
    pay_agg_dict = {
        'avg_total_payment': ('total_payment', 'mean'),
        'avg_avg_installments': ('avg_installments', 'mean'),
        'avg_count_payments': ('count_payments', 'mean'),
        'sum_total_payment': ('total_payment', 'sum'),
    }
    for c in pay_rate_cols:
        pay_agg_dict[c.replace('pay_type_', 'pay_rate_')] = (c, 'mean')
    agg_pay = product_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(**pay_agg_dict).reset_index()

    # --- Отзывы: учитываем только отзывы, уже созданные на seed_time ---
    reviews_f = reviews[reviews['order_id'].isin(order_ids)].copy()
    reviews_f = reviews_f[reviews_f['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]

    rev_agg = reviews_f.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
    ).reset_index()

    product_rev = product_orders.merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    agg_rev = product_rev.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'mean'),
        min_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'min'),
        total_reviews=('review_count', 'sum'),
        review_count_per_order=('review_count', 'mean'),
        review_coverage=('review_count', lambda s: (s > 0).mean()),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Объединение ---
    features = agg_item.merge(agg_pay, on='product_id', how='left') \
                       .merge(agg_rev, on='product_id', how='left')
    features = features.set_index('product_id')
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.fillna(0).astype(float)

    return features
